root_idea.summary: The root centers on things being gathered closely together, producing narrowness or constriction.
root_idea.development: From physical closeness and dense gathering, the semantic range develops toward confined space, difficulty, inner distress, sin or blame, and related states of restriction; several specialized nominal branches retain the idea of dense or closely joined material.

senses.definition: Constriction, distress, difficulty, or uneasiness; of the chest, a state of being constricted and unreceptive to what is good or right.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for burdensome difficulty and inward constraint, including the construction of a person's chest becoming narrow or constricted. The Quranic uses include both general difficulty and spiritual or emotional constriction.

senses.definition: Sin, blame, or objectionable liability; in لا حرج, absence of blame, sin, or harm in doing something.
senses.usage_conditions: The no-haraj construction removes blame or sin from an act and can accordingly be rendered as there being no blame, fault, or objection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become collected together and close, strait, or narrow; said of things that gather tightly, including dust collected in a confined place.
To become inwardly constricted or disquieted; to be doubtful or in doubt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's bosom or inner state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become straitened through sin or wrongdoing, and hence to commit a punishable sin, crime, or act of disobedience.
Of the eye, to become dazzled or sunken in its socket, with vision narrowed; also to remain fixed without turning or blinking through intense gazing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized use applied to the eye.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become forbidden or prohibited, especially as something attended by constraint or difficulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in constructions describing a wrong, a meal, or prayer as prohibited.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To betake oneself or have recourse to someone or something for protection from constraint or difficulty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction حَرِجَ إِلَى expresses turning to or seeking refuge in a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something strait or difficult, or to forbid violation of a right; in a warning addressed to a serpent, to threaten it with pursuit and expulsion if it returns.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The serpent wording is a specialized warning construction built on the causative sense of imposing constraint.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To force a person or animal into a narrow or confined place; by extension, to constrain someone to seek recourse or to cause him to need something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a person, a dog, or another beast; the construction with إِلَى expresses constraint toward a refuge, person, or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to fall into difficulty or a strait.
To cause someone to fall into a punishable sin, crime, or act of disobedience.
To declare or pronounce prayer forbidden.
To give a dog a portion of the prey or game it has taken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized hunting use, distinct from the causative meanings of making something difficult or confined.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a matter strait or difficult for oneself.
To put away, shun, avoid, or keep aloof from sin or crime.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction تَحَرَّجَ مِنْهُ expresses avoiding something as sinful or criminal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The portion of prey or game given to a dog, such as a piece of flesh or specified parts of the carcass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a hunting noun; its plural is reported as أَحْرَاجٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cowry shell.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural forms include أَحْرَاجٌ, أَحْرِجَةٌ, and حِرَاجٌ; the shells may be hung around dogs' necks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collar made of cowry shells for a dog or other animal.
Of a she-camel: lean, lank, slender, or light in flesh; variant descriptions also include sharp-spirited, large-bodied, long, or strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are reported variant descriptions in the specialized application to a she-camel and should not be generalized to the ordinary noun حَرَجٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden framework or vehicle used to carry the dead, including a bier-cover or a headless conveyance for women or men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to a structure of bound wood placed over a bier or to a vehicle used for carrying people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strait, narrow, confined, or close place, especially a densely wooded place impenetrable to grazing animals.
A person whose bosom is strait or contracted and does not expand toward what is good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the adjectival or participial use of حَرِجٌ applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who fears or dreads venturing upon an affair.
One who seldom or never withdraws from battle and is not readily put to flight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized description is explained as if withdrawal were difficult to justify.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who commits a sin, crime, or punishable act of disobedience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is distinct from the contrary use in which the same form describes abstention from sin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who abstains from, shuns, or keeps away from sin or crime.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical record reports this as a contrary signification to the sense of committing sin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Forbidden or prohibited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction describing another person's wronging as prohibited to the speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wood, thicket, or dense and tangled collection of trees; also a tree or wooded place inaccessible to grazing animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes a dense gathering of trees, with several reported plural or collective forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collection of camels, also specified as a hundred camels.
Dense darkness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression حِرَاجُ الظَّلْمَاءِ and related variants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dog wearing a collar of cowry shells.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This derived adjective denotes the animal marked by cowries around its neck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression حَلَفَ بِالْمُحَرَّجَاتِ, the three divorces that make a wife absolutely forbidden to her former husband, or constricting oaths that narrow a person's available scope.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an idiomatic oath expression.

cautions: The Quranic form group combines the noun and adjective uses of حَرَجٌ across its inflected Quran occurrences; related vocalized headwords such as حَرِجٌ and حِرْجٌ remain separately represented in the Classical meanings.
